name: Tandem Heel-to-Toe Walk

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: CDC STEADI Balance Training & Otago Exercise Programme

steps: Stand tall near a wall or countertop so you have a support surface within reach if needed.
Place the heel of your right foot directly in front of the toes of your left foot, touching or nearly touching.
Focus your eyes on a fixed point on the wall ahead to help maintain stability.
Take a step forward with your left foot, placing your left heel directly in front of your right toes.
Continue stepping forward in a straight line for 10 to 15 deliberate steps.
coaching_cues: Keep your arms outstretched to your sides like a tightrope walker if helpful for balance.
Move with slow, deliberate precision rather than rushing forward.
Stand as tall as possible through your crown.

sources.attribution: Otago Exercise Programme Fall Prevention Guidelines
